pages.text: Health 360, Attack 12, Armor 12, Armor Toughness 6, Speed 0.25, Knockback Resistance 1.0.$(br)Immune to fall, drowning, suffocation and freezing damage; source-less damage and freezing are cut by 50%%.

$(l)Damage cap$(): never more than 20 from a single hit; it is invulnerable for 0.75 seconds after every hit it takes, though wither damage does not set off that special invulnerability window; if one hit actually costs it 12 or more health, or it is standing in lava / powder snow, it teleports away.$(br)$(l)Recovery$(): heals 1 health per second; it cannot heal for 5 seconds after taking wither damage, or while it is withered.

$(l)Interrupt$(): taking more than 30 damage in total while winding up a move breaks it off and blinks him backwards. Each necromancer on the field cuts the charge time by 20%%; each extra servant type cuts another 5%%, down to a floor of 50%%.$(br)$(l)Green Fire$(): undead flame. It does nothing to the undead and deals 1.5x damage to anything living.$(br)$(l)Nameless Beam$(): fires one piercing nameless beam for 12 damage; where the beam touches a block it sets off Green Fire.

$(l)Raising the Dead$(): winds up, then summons 3 Vanguards, 3 Blackguards and 3 random 50-health necromancers, drawn up in three rows. Cooldown 30 seconds.$(br)Borrowed Power (a winding-up move): Green Smith charges for 1 second and then uses an elite necromancer's move. Cooldown 10 seconds, and one is picked at random each time:$(br)the Drowned Necromancer's Trident Storm (locking onto targets rather than fixed spots), the Wild Necromancer's thorn ball (3 in a spread), the Reaper Necromancer's rotating scythes (three in a spread), the Skull Lord's Haunted Skulls (2 waves, 7 apiece).

$(l)Gloom-Eroding Moonlight$(): after a 1.5-second charge it looses a corrupted laser beam that turns slowly and only ever locks onto 1 target. Cooldown 30 seconds.$(br)$(l)Cavalry Over the Ridge$(): Green Smith grants every servant within 32 blocks, and himself, Iron Hide I for 10 seconds; he also lays Rallying I and Shielded I on himself and on his necromancer servants, restores 10-15 health and 10 seconds of Necrosis I to every ally, and gives out 30 seconds of sunlight immunity. Cooldown 30 seconds.

$(l)Wind Stills but Sorrow Stays$(): Green Smith looses a Wind Blast that swats down projectiles closing in on him and leaps backwards, calling up 6 clones to work their moves alongside him.$(br)$(l)Clone moves$(): Moonlight - lasers fire out in six directions for 1 second.$(br)Raising the Dead - each clone summons one random skeleton servant variant.$(br)Borrowed Power - uses another elite necromancer's move.$(br)Cavalry Over the Ridge - heals alongside him.$(br)Cooldown 20 seconds.

$(l)Netherfire Covers the Sky$(): Green Smith unfolds a field for 20 seconds, hammering the area with green lightning over and over - 5 damage a bolt, 4 blocks of radius - and wherever a bolt falls it leaves Green Fire and summons one skeleton servant of any kind. On top of that, every 20 ticks Green Smith fires lightning straight at 4 hostile creatures inside the field, at 16 blocks of range. While this lasts he does not move, but he has 80%% damage reduction. Cooldown 80 seconds.$(br)$(l)Soul Jar upgrades$(): give Green Smith any soul jar and it can be upgraded twice.

What each soul jar level grants:$(br)Soul Beam damage +1, projectile speed +10%%, servant lifespan +30 seconds, scythe projectile speed and width +10%%, poison dart damage +1 and speed +10%%, Inspiration duration +2.5 seconds and healing +2.5, clone healing +4, clone laser duration +0.25 seconds, Wind Blast radius +0.5, field damage reduction +2.5%%, thorn damage +3 and thorn radius +1 block with speed +10%%, Haunted Skull explosion power +0.5, direct damage +1 with speed +10%%,$(br)and at full level the servants he summons come with Buff I, while the Shielded he hands out rises to level 2.

You may also feed Green Smith an elite necromancer's soul jar so that, when he summons, he has a chance to call up one elite necromancer instead of three ordinary ones.$(br)$(l)If Goety$(): Cataclysm is installed you can give him a Draugr Necromancer's soul jar instead, so that when he summons he has a chance to swap 1 ordinary necromancer for a Draugr Necromancer.

Extra summons:$(br)Green Smith can be given focuses to summon extra creatures.$(br)Grave Soul Focus (Goety: Ominous): Haunt, 3 per cast, cap 6$(br)$(l)Spooky Focus$(): Wraith, 2 per cast, cap 2$(br)$(l)Reaper Focus$(): Reaper, 2 per cast, cap 2$(br)$(l)Phantasm Focus$(): Phantom, 2 per cast, cap 2$(br)Redstone Focus (Goety: Ominous): Grave Golem, 2 per cast, cap 2
$(l)If Goety$(): Twilight is installed, a Vexing Focus can be given as well.$(br)$(l)Vexing Focus$(): Wraith, 2 per cast, cap 2
